Come in through the front door.

A bakery rooted in the Afropean experience — making spaces for belonging through bread, travel, design and the table. Landscapes become recipes; recipes become memory.

Set your table with the things we make.

A few favourites from the pantry — the bakes we are known for and our coffee. Tap any one to see what's inside, the price and add it to your basket.

Who we are

Food is culture. Ingredients tell stories.

Everything we make is guided by three principles — and a belief that food carries geography, migration, history and people.

Belonging over perfection

A table set for arrival, not for show. The first thing we bake is welcome.

Care over control

We follow the ingredient, the season and the hands that made it — and let go of the rest.

Curiosity over rigidity

Every recipe is a question about geography, migration and memory, asked out loud.

About our coffee
From the source

About our coffee

Every cup of coffee starts long before it reaches our morning routine. It starts with the seed, the soil and the people who care for it every single day.

Archival discovery drops

A place you can open.

Each drop tells the story of one country through carefully curated objects and ingredients. Every box should feel like opening a museum collection — never a gift hamper.

Baked to order, set your table.

Pastries and seasonal bakes, made and packed to order. Add to your basket and we will be in touch to confirm your bake date and delivery.
